Because our series is a convergent alternating series, the alternating series error bound applies. In particular, for the second partial sum, it states that [MATH: |S - {s_2}| < |{b_3}| =\left| \dfrac{(-1)^{3}}{\sqrt[4]{3^5}} \right|=\dfrac{{1}}{\sqrt[4]{243}}.]

Therefore, [MATH: k=\dfrac{{1}}{\sqrt[4]{243}}.]
